saw_lines: People join a community app after landing in a new city, and stay only once one first meeting feels easy.
So the sign-up happens on the first screen, when a stranger checks whether the city has anyone for them.
Your site leads with 17,000+ members in 130+ countries, so put that number in the headline of both Google creatives, the text and the image.
